name: Protected repository rulesets and change constraints

attribution.legal_posture: This is analyst-applied defensive context derived from generic first-party product documentation; it describes controls. Incident attribution, actor finding, legal allegation, adjudication, and measured effectiveness require separate evidence.

caveats: Account, handle, repository, portfolio, commit, and image similarity identify evidence types; legal identity requires source-explicit linkage or authoritative corroboration.
Keep fake-interview malware separate from fraudulent employment unless a source explicitly connects the same account or operator to both activities.

Signed commits prove possession of a signing credential; legal identity and physical location require separate evidence. Combine controls with least privilege, independent review, credential hygiene, and post-hire access monitoring.

statements: GitHub rulesets can constrain pushes and branch or tag operations, require signed commits, and block force pushes for selected repository scopes.
limitations: Signed commits prove possession of a signing credential, not a person's legal identity or physical location. Combine controls with least privilege, independent review, credential hygiene, and post-hire access monitoring.
